8ffe89d2-c521-4b3b-b6a6-bc42944c4e9f.title: Lucas — Refined quiet-desk typography
8ffe89d2-c521-4b3b-b6a6-bc42944c4e9f.visualDirection: Minimal Inter menu and compact AI composer over unchanged approved desk photograph. v1=image-only baseline, v2=GPT-5.6 Sol proposal, v3=mobile/focus corrections, v4=top-centred Brussels local-time badge with requested black/monospace/green treatment and mobile spacing adjustments. v5 reduces only the Brussels badge (desktop32px high; mobile24px high). v6=approved upright Newsreader 400 name with quieter Inter role/menu/chat, mobile input 16px and otherwise unchanged composition. v7=minimum 44px menu touch target correction. v8=one-second staggered entrance for name, role, About, Contact, and chat, with 8px upward movement, reduced-motion support and immediate completion on focus/open; About copy synchronized and Approach hidden. v9=removed composer focus-within highlight and input focus-visible outline; autofocus, typing, and focus indicators for other controls retained. v10=compact resting chat invitation: 12px Lucas’s AI assistant caption, Ask about Lucas placeholder, 50px composer with 14px corners, and a 32px circular send affordance inside a 44px target that activates for non-whitespace text; all panels, photograph, clock, motion and no-highlight behavior preserved. Design preview only; not yet mirrored into frontend. v11=user-requested personal voice: resting entry is only Ask me anything with no assistant caption, short screens retain an Ask me anything button, chat heading and placeholders match, first-person example replies use the supplied profile facts, repeated assistant labels removed. A small AI-generated replies disclosure is visible only inside chat. Focus returns to a visible control when resizing between input and compact-button layouts. Design preview only; frontend/backend remain unchanged. v12=user-requested spatial conversation: one persistent bottom-centred Ask me anything composer; desktop replies appear in speech bubbles to the left of the head, positioned using the exact photograph cover/crop geometry. Chat is a nonmodal conversation region with no backdrop or focus trap. Tablet/phone and narrow desktop fall back to a compact reading panel above the same composer, with expansion for long conversations and a forced reading layout for short viewports. History survives minimizing, focus avoids reopening the mobile keyboard, input stays 16px, reply motion respects reduced motion, and completed replies use a polite status announcement. Photo/clock/About/Contact remain unchanged; first-person example replies and discreet AI disclosure retained. Design preview only; frontend and backend unchanged. v13=user-approved v12 layout retained with refined conversation scrolling: all messages remain available, an overflow-only hint makes history discoverable, scrolling away from the bottom shows Latest reply, minimizing/reopening preserves the reading offset, and incoming replies only follow while the reader is at the bottom. Hidden panels do not reset scroll state; a small upward scroll stops following; jump-to-latest retains visible keyboard focus. No change to composer or speech-bubble placement. Design preview only; frontend and backend unchanged. v14=desktop portrait-side chat aligns Lucas response bubbles, including Thinking, to the right and visitor prompts to the left. The visitor bubble corner is mirrored to the bottom left; Lucas reply tail continues toward the head. Mobile/tablet styles, scrolling, composer, layout geometry, and all JavaScript remain unchanged. Design preview only; application code unchanged. v15=About and Contact navigation removed. Three clickable prompt bubbles sit directly above the bottom composer: What do you work with?, What's your background?, How can I reach you?. Suggestions disappear while conversation is open and return when minimized; short visible viewports use a horizontally scrollable row, normal phone widths wrap. Clicking submits through the shared form, preserves an existing typed draft, guards pending replies, and focuses a chat control rather than opening the mobile keyboard. Contact replies now contain the original verified LinkedIn/GitHub links instead of referring to the removed menu. Existing photograph, name, role, clock, desktop right/left message alignment and history behavior retained. Design preview only; application source unchanged. v16=visible Scroll through the conversation hint removed. Per user clarification, only desktop portrait-side chat fades whole bubbles uniformly, including borders and tails, instead of applying a mask to a clipped scroll viewport. Real message nodes paint outside the scroll clip while a native spacer retains the conversation history. Oversized desktop messages scroll internally inside an intact outer bubble. Desktop caption/minimize controls sit to the left of the conversation column so they do not overlap fading cards. Compact mobile/tablet chat retains its existing normal-flow scrolling and does not fade. Previous identity, photograph, clock, prompt examples, contact links, composer, and left/right desktop alignment retained. Design preview only; application source unchanged. v17=question/reply exchanges have 32px separation while retaining 12px within a pair. Desktop whole-card opacity now fades progressively with pair distance, keeping the newest exchange clear and shifting the readable area with history scrolling; 180ms opacity easing respects reduced motion. Rounded whole-bubble painting, long-message reading areas and left/right alignment retained. Compact mode gets the larger pair spacing but keeps ordinary non-fading scrolling. Design preview only; application source unchanged.

A partially faded earlier reply remained a complete rounded card above the transcript boundary (top 185px versus transcript top 307px), with uniform opacity 0.285531. Latest visible replies remained fully opaque.

verification.longMessage: A 1400-character message kept an intact 318px outer bubble. Its 302px inner reading area contained 630px of text and scrolled independently by 200px; bringing the card into view made it fully opaque.
verification.compactLayouts: At 390x844 and 768x1024, messages returned to relative positioning and content wrappers used display:contents; spacer hidden, no mask, no horizontal page overflow. Existing mobile/tablet transcript scrolling retained.
verification.controls: Final desktop screenshot verified caption/minimize controls clear the fading cards: header right edge 533px, transcript left edge 549px. The header retains its original 44px layout height, preserving conversation geometry.
verification.contentAndScope: Visible scroll hint removed everywhere. Public assets, identity, profile facts, example prompts, contact URLs, composer and desktop left/right alignment retained. Changes remain in the public design preview only.

pairSpacingAndFade.method: Direct refinement of the existing public preview. No private project source uploaded.

desktop.threeExchanges: Observed six whole message cards. Newest prompt/reply opacity 1; preceding pair opacity 0.78197; oldest reply opacity 0.104674. Whole cards fade without a viewport gradient mask or clipped rounded edges.
desktop.historyScroll: Native wheel scrolling moved scrollTop from 77 to 0. Oldest prompt/reply opacity increased to 0.914206; the middle pair reached 0.992171; the newest exchange faded below the reading area.
desktop.latestReply: Clicking Latest reply returned scrollTop to 77 (453px content, 376px viewport) and restored opacity 1 for the newest prompt and response.
desktop.visualReview: Desktop screenshot inspected; larger exchange spacing and progressively fainter older bubbles visible.

mobile.visualReview: Mobile screenshot inspected. Conversation retains ordinary scrolling without desktop fading.

sourceChecks.independentReview: No double-counted spacing or fade regression found. Desktop pair spacing is counted once in logical offsets; docked spacing combines 12px gap with 20px margin. Existing reduced-motion override covers the new desktop opacity transition.

verification.scope: Public design preview only. No application source changes, private source upload, or actual backend API test.

desktopNestedScrollFix.scope: Frontend implementation only; public design draft and backend unchanged.
desktopNestedScrollFix.behavior: Desktop Latest reply no longer changes transcript height. Vertical wheel gestures consume available long-message movement first, forward the residual delta to conversation history, and retain that handoff during the gesture. Pointer focus uses preventScroll; keyboard focus remains revealable. Scroll positions are protected from layout and streaming races. Mobile/tablet remain native.

browserVerification.latestControl: Desktop Latest reply remained outside the message column at x=419.28..533px and did not resize the transcript.

mobileTabletFocusScrollFix.scope: Frontend compact layouts only; desktop portrait design, public design draft, API contract, and backend unchanged.
mobileTabletFocusScrollFix.behavior: Composer pointer focus uses preventScroll and the document is locked to the single-screen experience below 1100px. Keyboard-sized VisualViewport changes keep the compact layout instead of forcing reading mode or hiding the identity. The conversation is bottom-anchored to the composer, prompt chips retain one row on phones, and Latest reply occupies the fixed-height header instead of changing transcript height.

browserVerification.history: Scrolling upward moved the latest reply from y=355px to y=475px; the down-arrow restored y=355px and hid itself.

desktopReplyFaceAnchor.automatedVerification: Focused layout suite passed 20 tests. Full frontend suite passed 107 tests across 18 files; typecheck, production build, and git diff --check passed.

implementation.chat: Streams from POST /api/v1/lucasai/stream via the existing Nuxt backend proxy. Latest-user-only request contract, stream pacing, safe Markdown, error handling and abort cleanup retained. No backend or heartbeat changes.
implementation.features: Bottom Ask me anything composer, no About/Contact navigation or chat modal, three prompt suggestions, verified contact links, preserved typed drafts and in-memory conversation history, minimize/reopen, subtle arrow-only latest navigation, desktop left prompts/right replies and Thinking, 12px within exchanges and 32px between them, progressive whole-bubble fading on desktop only.
implementation.mobile: Docked touch-scrolling conversation bottom-anchored above the composer; keyboard-aware VisualViewport and safe-area layout prevents automatic reading-mode jumps. Phone suggestions keep one horizontal row, Latest reply stays in the stable panel header, and the compact document cannot pan behind the chat. Existing explicit/true-short-viewport reading mode remains.
implementation.streamingRefinement: On large screens the newest reply is calibrated to the face and stays at that position throughout streaming; native trailing history space moves older exchanges upward without synthetic transforms. Long reply bodies and outer history retain coordinated scroll intent. Compact layouts keep native touch scrolling, a stable transcript viewport, and bottom-anchored streaming growth. Scrolling older content pauses automatic following until the arrow is selected.

verification.desktop: At 1440x900, three consecutive short replies and every phase of a long streamed reply began at y=355px beside the face. History scrolling moved the latest reply naturally; the arrow restored the exact anchor. Existing left/right positioning, fading, composer styling, and nested scrolling remained intact.
verification.history: Native wheel moved desktop history to 27px; minimize/reopen preserved 27px and all six messages. During another streamed response, scrollTop remained 509px as the reply grew from 1427 to 1989 characters.
verification.longReply: A 318px intact bubble held a 284px body with 1614px content. Body followed to 1329.5px; native upward scrolling reached 979.5px and revealed Latest reply. Latest restored 1329.5px.
verification.responsive: Phone and tablet messages stayed relative and fully opaque with no document panning. Pointer focus kept scrollY at 0; keyboard-sized focused viewports kept compact mode and the identity visible. Latest reply visibility changed transcript height by 0px. Explicit and true-short-viewport reading mode remains covered.
